idea: Little science wonder – WIND (SUNNY PARK, Ava in OUTDOOR pink overalls): a gust of wind makes Baby Ava's colorful toy pinwheel (red, yellow, blue, green) spin round and round beside her face ('Whoosh! Wow! My pinwheel spins!'); the wind stops and the pinwheel stops ('Oh no! It stopped! No more wind!'); she makes her own wind and blows on it – copy-me 'Blow, blow, blow! Round and round! Blow with me!'; orange and yellow autumn leaves swirl around her ('Whoosh, whoosh! The leaves dance too!'); she asks the viewer 'What makes them move? Hmm?' (2 s humming pause) – 'The wind! The wind! Whoosh, whoosh!'; lesson 'I can't see the wind, but I see it move!'; copy-me 'Wave your arms like the wind! Yay!'. Loop: the hook framing again with the pinwheel spinning, 'Bye bye, wind! Bye bye, friends!'.
lesson: Wind is moving air: we cannot see it, but we can see it move things (a pinwheel spins, leaves dance); we can make wind ourselves by blowing.
calendar: Saturday slot 2 – Little science wonder (earlier: little seed 31 Oct, float/sink 14 Nov, ice melts 21 Nov). Wind/air is new.

variety.outfit: OUTDOOR (pink overalls over a yellow t-shirt)

characters: BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing pink overalls over a yellow t-shirt with a small flower and white sneakers with pink laces.
supporting: THE PINWHEEL = a big cute toy pinwheel on a short white stick, with exactly FOUR curved petals in plain solid colors – one red, one yellow, one blue, one green – and a small round white button in the middle; no patterns, no letters. AUTUMN LEAVES = a few big simple orange and yellow leaves (shot 3 only).

learning.goal: Wind is moving air you cannot see, but it moves things – and blowing makes wind too.
learning.shown_how: Shot 1 the pinwheel spins in a gust and Ava's curls flutter, then it stops; shot 2 Ava blows and it spins again; shot 3 leaves swirl around her in the breeze; shot 4 thinking pose for the question, then arms waving like the wind; shot 5 pinwheel spinning, bye wave.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:15 'What makes them move? Hmm?' + 0:17-0:19 humming-only pause (silencedetect 17.3-19.9) -> 0:19 'The wind! The wind!' + cheer

learning.fact_check: Pinwheel has exactly 4 petals (red, yellow, blue, green) in every frame; leaves only from shot 3; no letters/numbers anywhere; the science is right (moving air turns a pinwheel; blowing = moving air).
learning.modeling: Ava solves the problem herself by blowing; nothing wrong to correct.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, bright soft daylight, big pinwheel beside her face, nothing scary.
